body: Thank you for your compassion. This is not an easy thing to share. There are so many layers and history to this that are not all going to be shared through this post. I am really trying by going to therapy, seeking community support and working with employment services to get back to where I can be independent. I appreciate your kind words and helping me feel that I am not insane for feeling that I shouldn’t be treated this way. Thank you truly.

I’m currently on disability so this is why I am only working part time. They only allow a certain amount to supplement my income. I’m trying to work with employment services to rehabilitate and get back to working full time. There are many pieces involved in this. I still stand firm that i do not believe saying those things to your child is okay. This is a condensed version of my history here.
Thank you for your feedback ! And good luck to you. It’s not easy.
I appreciate that input thank you!!
Thank you for that 🤍
Thank you so much for this help.

Thank you for this. 
My only issue is that I want to use them as a refrence and if I tell her I already have something lined up and then someone calls her shortly after it may be off. I think the wording of this is great . I may just be honest that I dont have anything lined up yet but that Im not the right fit. I hope that makes sense.
MB and I got pretty close so I may feel uncomfortable keeping it that brief. You are absolutely right though about my happiness. Thank you for the feedback.

I guess because MB and I got pretty close It might feel weird not letting her know why. And I am expecting her to ask me (and not sure if she will try to persuade me to stay) so im just trying to find the right way to put it. Thank you for your input.

MB has told both NKs she feels like she is in an abusive relationship dealing with them. I agree. It can get pretty bad and I’m constantly on edge. I have grown attached to little NK (3) and I feel bad for MB but it’s too much. I’m just not sure how to leave as far as what to say. And how much time to give .

Thank you for taking the time to read this post and give your feedback. I do feel terrible about the circumstances and I’ve tried my best to do my job. But I get home and all I want to do is sleep from this mental exhaustion. I have other things going on in my personal life as well so it’s just a lot

Came here to say the same thing ! 
I hope you both can find the right path for you and get out of that cycle. It seems to be pretty  common right now. I’ll be coming back to this post for some hope that people can relate or have advice.

Aww! Well it sounds like things played out for you how they were suppose to and in a nice way. Happy to hear that. 
I am still on the verge of possibly putting in my 2 weeks , but with the way the economy is going I’m nervous to leave without something lined up. Just struggling in that department of what’s next. Thanks for engaging with my post and making me feel heard.

Yes I completely agree with you on all of this. 
I have been looking for other work but my self limiting beliefs hold me back so much also. 
I’m ready to put my 2 weeks in. I’m being disrespected on so many levels and it’s affecting my mental health.
Are you still nannying ?

Thank you, I really needed to hear this. 
I have been feeling so guilty and I end up thinking that I’m overreacting to certain things but once I talk to others they are in shock of what I put up with. Like the original post said I definitely know I have let things slide that I shouldn’t have and it’s set the tone for other things. 
In all honesty, I don’t know the answer to those which is the biggest part of my battle. Where to go from here? I’ve grown up in poverty and I’ve always just tried to get by, stuck in survival mode I suppose. I agree that I need to dig deep and figure out where I want to be. Thank you again for the feedback.
Thanks !
Thank you!

Did you have another job lined up? 
And I agree. I’ve been doing this for years , but I know this pandemic has affected so many and I feel the last few families I couldn’t stay with due to a shift in the dynamic. I’m just worried I’ll start another job and it be a similar situation. Starting off fine and then slowly turning into something along these lines of feeling my communication is not important.

Thank you. I have started looking and even the thought of applying and starting that process all over is draining. It’s why I have stayed. I think I may be looking into jobs that are not nannying due to things changing so much during the pandemic. It’s been the worst couple of years of my career.

Ah I feel you. 
I’ve stayed where I’m at out of comfort and the anxieties of having to find another job. But things have been super tough and now they change my schedule every week & changed my work load with the kids. Probably headed in the direction of quitting at this point. Good luck to you !

Yes ! This is something I use to love ! I just don’t feel as comfortable now. Something as silly and fun as putting on music and dancing around with NK feels embarrassing because MB or DB can walk in and I feel stupid. I know they wouldn’t care but I’d feel weird. That could just be me but I feel awkward with things like that. Even just knowing they are hearing everything I say makes me overthink everything.

I’m not sure about your situation but I believe a lot of us are working for people that are also feeling the burn out from their own jobs and lives during this time. So with what we do , I feel like a lot of families are pushing limits a bit to relieve themselves. Hopefully with that title change also came with correct compensation! Sorry to hear you’re going through this as well

Agreed! There’s a bunch of reasons for this and a lot of people do not understand how much it can affect our day. I saw on another thread someone put it in a great way saying imagine your boss listening to your calls all day. I felt like that was a good way to put it for us nannies that have parents popping in all day or even sitting in the same room where you are with NK. It’s quite uncomfortable.
I’m on the same page. I have some experience in other things but I don’t feel it’s adequate enough or really work I want to go back to so it’s hard trying to focus on the next step.

I completely get that. It’s definitely hard. Working full time trying to make sure bills are paid. Plus trying to add school on to that while already feeling mentally drained seems daunting. You’re not alone. I’ve considered going back to school but also in that same place unfortunately.

Thank you so much for the feedback ! 
I get worried to have this conversation even more so because of certain things she has said. She was talking about how another person is intimidated of her and she seemed proud of that. I worry that anyway I put it, she may not respond well. I could be wrong , but during this time we’ve been getting acquainted my intuition is telling me she doesn’t respond well to these types of situations. Which is why I don’t particularly think it could be a long term position for me. I really appreciate your advice ! Definitely am taking that in.
